items.a: The SalesMade Academy is aimed at B2B sales teams that want to systematically improve their conversion rates and achieve predictable revenue. Ideal for companies with 5–50 sellers who are willing to invest in professional training.

items.q: How much time does my team need to invest?
items.a: The programme spans 12 months with 90 minutes of live training per month, 120 minutes of group coaching and self-paced learning. The content is practical and directly applicable in day-to-day business.

items.q: What happens if we see no results?
items.a: We offer a 100% money-back guarantee. If after 90 days you see no measurable improvements in your KPIs, we refund the full investment. No questions asked.

items.q: Can we send individual employees only?
items.a: Yes, that is possible. However, the best results appear when the entire team trains together. That way a unified sales language and methodology emerges across the company.

items.q: What sets the Academy apart from classic trainings?
items.a: 6-day classroom trainings are out — and for pretty good reasons. The SalesMade Academy is a digital, AI-powered platform with personal sparring through experienced sales leaders. We pick up every team member exactly where they are today and lead them step by step, month by month, through the right skills.

finalCta.subtext: How convincingly does your software sales team work in direct comparison? Our no-obligation benchmark can give you valuable insights. Your team runs through a realistic customer scenario in which we observe and assess 13 decisive sales skills.

meta.title: Discovery Call Scorecard — SalesMade
meta.description: 8 questions. 60 seconds. See exactly where your discovery calls leak money.

scorecard.headline: How effective are your discovery calls?
scorecard.subtext: 8 questions. 60 seconds. See exactly where your discovery calls leak money — and what we would change with you.
questions: I know at least 3 concrete pain points of my ICP — not guesses.
For every lead, I know why they would buy NOW (not in 6 months).
In my discovery calls I talk less than 30 % of the time.
I hear the buyer say "this is in our budget" before I name a price.
I know the internal decision-makers by name before I send an offer.
I have a clear "next step" at the end of every discovery call — no hope, no follow-up.
I can explain in one sentence what my customers do differently AFTER we work together.
I know why my last lost deal was lost — data-based, not gut-feel.
scorecard.wantReportBody: We send a 4-page email analysis of your score with concrete recommendations. Free, no follow-up spam.
scorecard.reportSent: Check your inbox — the report is on its way.

tiers.label: Discovery needs structure
tiers.body: You’re selling on instinct — and losing deals because no one understands why customers are better off with you. That’s a system problem, not a talent problem.

tiers.label: Gaps in practice
tiers.body: You’ve read the methods, but in the call you slip back to old patterns. Discovery calls go friendly but rarely into a clear next step.

tiers.label: Solid foundation
tiers.body: You’re doing many things right. What’s missing: a sparring partner who tells you live where you lose the buyer — step by step.

tiers.label: Discovery Master (Top 5 %)
tiers.body: You’re in the top 5 % who master discovery. The question now: can you teach others? That’s the next leverage — team enablement.
